html.title: HTML
html.descr: The variety of HTML-tags is amazing. I consider it blasphemy to neglect it by using exclusively <div> and <span> everywhere to display all the web-content.
html.caption: «Semantic and clean HTML-code»

css.title: CSS
css.descr: Who among us doesn't like when «beautiful and modern»? I love it very much, so I follow the trends of the CSS world to make my web-apps not only beautiful, but also modern!
css.caption: «Modern CSS by the BEM rules»

js.title: JS
js.descr: JavaScript: the gift and curse of web-development. So simple, but so complex. So flat, but so multifaceted. JavaScript. I love you. I hate you.
js.caption: «Vanilla JS with split into modules imitation»

flutter.title: Flutter
flutter.descr: Flutter is a multiplatform framework for mobile development. Under the hood it uses a «Dart», which was supposed to be a «JavaScript killer» (haha, very funny). By the way, the process of creating a frontend in mobile development is also called «layouting» (process of turning designs into real working UI, just like in Web).
flutter.caption: «Just basic Flutter-App example»
